intro: New York City listings advertise 10x10 units from about $143 (and small lockers from single digits), while typical non-climate 10x10 street rates in the five boroughs run about $270/month — more than double the national average. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, your six-month average sits well above the banner price.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Climate-controlled ~$83–$94.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap). Climate-controlled ~$156–$184.

Most rented size. City average ~$270 (StorageCafe, StorageUnitCosts); the wider NY–NJ metro averages $220 (Storage Stats, Oct 2026), so New Jersey and Long Island facilities can be cheaper. Climate-controlled ~$272–$339.
Two-bedroom contents. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$406.
Three-bedroom home. Climate-controlled ~$523–$713; few drive-up units in Manhattan.

local_tips: Prices swing hard by borough: StorageCafe lists Hunts Point (~$119), Concourse Village (~$140) and Rockaway Beach (~$148) among the cheapest areas for a standard unit, while Yorkville, Hunters Point and the Upper West Side run $400–$550.
Rates are lowest around February and highest in August (StorageCafe); avoid booking during the summer moving peak if you can.
Many Manhattan facilities show "contact for pricing" — ask for the online rate and the full move-in total in writing before you commit.
Extra Space charges a $50 admin fee (per StorageUnitCosts), higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
